text:
Mara: Heads-up — Brightline billing contacted CS. They saw ~2.2M extra embed events on the Feb invoice. Looks like duplicate webhook replays after SDK v3.2.1 deploy. tagging @Kevin
Kevin: On it. I see a replay job rep-20240214 that retried without dedupe keys. Preliminary count shows ~1.9M duplicates. Pulling logs now.
Tina: Customer asking for a credit. Do we have a recommended amount?
Mara: Finance calc below — if all 1.9M were billed at the embed SKU ($0.0004 per embed) that's $760. But want to confirm billable vs rate-limited events before final.
Mara: ```-- quick query used to approximate duplicates
SELECT customer_id, sum(duplicate_count) as dups
FROM billing.audit_events
WHERE job_id = 'rep-20240214' AND customer_id = 'brightline'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
billing-bot: Automated audit result: duplicate_count=1903100, customer_id=brightline, job_id=rep-20240214, verified_by=ing-replay.attachment
Oliver: Can we confirm these were charged? There was a regional rate cap bump that may have suppressed charges for some rows earlier in the pipeline. If many were suppressed, the credit should be smaller.
Kevin: Good call. I cross-checked raw ingest vs metering ledger: raw events show +1.9M, metering shows +1.9M as well — looks like they made it to billing. I pushed the job fix (PR https://git.redwood/replay/pull/458) to add idempotency keys and prevent future duplicates.
Mara: Request: approve one-time credit for $760 and a waiver of the late-payment policy for the invoice. CS will send the customer note. Approvers: @Oliver @Tina
Oliver: approve — thumbs up from my side. Please add a note in the invoice memo and on the customer record about the replay bug.
Tina: approve as well. Finance: please issue credit memo and cc CS. Also recommend we add a short summary paragraph to the customer email explaining root cause and the fix.
Mara: Thanks. I'll open the credit ticket and attach audit snapshots and the PR link. Ticket created: FIN-789 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-789). Assigning to Billing Ops for execution.
Kevin: Follow-up: replay job updated to write idempotency_id = event_hash; rolling out now. Will post rollback/verify logs once done. :thumbsup:
